user.title: Set up Itho Daalderop boiler
user.description: Enter the boiler serial number. You will sign in to your Itho Daalderop account in the next step; Home Assistant never receives your password.

auth_callback.title: Connect your Itho Daalderop account
auth_callback.description:
1. [Open the Itho Daalderop sign-in page]({login_url}) in a new tab. If the link is not clickable, copy the Login URL shown below.
2. Sign in. The browser may report that it cannot open `climateconnect://`; this is expected.
3. Copy the complete `climateconnect://login?token=...` address, or only the value beginning with `eyJ`, and paste it into the Token field.

Treat the token like a password.

data.login_url: Login URL (open or copy into a new tab)

data_description.login_url: This one-time Itho sign-in URL is generated automatically. Do not replace it.
data_description.token: Paste the callback URL or JWT returned after signing in.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the server
